rules.text: A weapon or tool found on the map that has a Freelancer rarity tier (Common, Rare, Epic or Legendary) is added to your Safehouse collection if you finish the mission with it in your inventory. This also works if you exit without eliminating all targets.

Weapons and tools without a rarity tier are lost when the mission ends. Everyday props (bananas, coins, propane flasks, kitchen knives, etc.) are not on any rarity list, so they are shown here as map-only items.
If the mission is failed (47 is wounded), the weapons found or brought on that mission are lost.
Rarity tiers on this site are matched by item name against the Hitman Wiki's Freelancer rarity lists. Items whose name is not on those lists are treated as map-only.

stashAndSafes.text: Stash and safe markers are pools of possible spawn spots, not fixed locations: the Paris guide counts sixteen possible stash spawns and eight possible safe spawns, and not every mission has a safe (the briefing tells you). A safe opens by scanning its three nearby clues (documents, laptops or tablets highlighted by Instinct) or with explosives. Stashes hold a random amount of Merces. How many spots are active per run is not documented.
